versions.content: The FrArTp shall reject the request for receive cancellation by returning E_NOT_OK when a) the cancelled connection is not active, or when b) the FrArTp has already received the last frame of an unacknowledged connection, or when c) the FrArTp has already provided the final AF of an acknowledged connection.
